claim: DXVK 3.1.1 subclasses the device window only in EnterFullscreenMode (fullscreen swapchain creation or a windowed-to-fullscreen Reset) and unhooks in LeaveFullscreenMode, the swapchain destructor and WM_DESTROY; a fullscreen-to-fullscreen Reset only changes the display mode. Launching straight into the final resolution hooks once, which is why 4K at launch survives
